verifier.statement: I read the source PDF directly rather than the repair plan: I extracted all seven pages with pdftotext -layout, then decompressed every page content stream and decoded the Identity-H text through each font’s ToUnicode CMap, so I could see the exact font (Times New Roman regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic, Arial and Arial Bold, Symbol), fill colour and x/y position of every run. I carved the DCTDecode image out of the PDF and looked at it (400x104 JPEG, sha256 1058ce9b..., byte-identical to the base64 embedded in the HTML). I decoded the page 5 form XObject and read its operators (0.666656 g grey fill from 117,146 to 542,417 plus 6pt Helvetica “(b) (4)”) and counted exactly four Symbol bullet markers with no accompanying text. I compared every page 6 table cell against the content stream, scanned all 101 objects including those inside object streams for /Annots, /Link and /URI (zero hits), and ran a word-level in-order diff of source text against the rebuilt HTML. Source sha256 c2c6b405... and HTML sha256 b342b7ac... both match the worksheet binding.
